question: Should Android expose ClawHub skill search/install review plus a read-scoped explicit `skills.securityVerdicts.items` lookup while keeping install/update enforcement in Gateway admin methods?
rationale: The code appears to preserve Gateway install/update enforcement, but adding a mobile install-management workflow and a read-scoped pre-install verdict query is a security-boundary and product-surface choice automation should not approve alone.

options.title: Accept after lint and proof
options.body: Require the ktlint fix and refreshed current-head Android proof, then accept the server-controlled verdict lookup because installs and updates still go through admin-gated Gateway methods.

options.title: Narrow the verdict API
options.body: Keep Android ClawHub search/install but remove or restrict explicit verdict lookups if read-scoped clients should not request arbitrary slug/version verdicts.

options.title: Defer Android install management
options.body: Pause or close this PR if Android should remain inspection-only until a broader skills-management product decision is made.

recommendation.title: Accept after lint and proof
recommendation.body: Require the ktlint fix and refreshed current-head Android proof, then accept the server-controlled verdict lookup because installs and updates still go through admin-gated Gateway methods.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across native ClawHub install flow and gateway skills/protocol boundary work.
